findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: describe_vocabulary · Private data: get_standard_details, describe_vocabulary · Public sink: get_assessment_blueprint, standards_for_claim · Destructive: get_subject_grade_tree.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: describe_vocabulary · Private data: get_standard_details, describe_vocabulary · Public sink: get_assessment_blueprint, standards_for_claim · Destructive: get_subject_grade_tree

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
